capture_ratio_definition: gross_bps / mfe_bps when mfe_bps > 0; not clipped
excursion_timing_definition: first bar attaining the canonical episode MFE/MAE, measured in hours from canonical entry

bootstrap.rationale: resample time blocks rather than individual trades so simultaneous and nearby trades across symbols/strategies are not treated as independent observations

multiplicity_policy.note: These stronger tests are reserved for later claims that would alter candidate selection, filtering, promotion, or deployment; this diagnostic does not make such claims.

preregistration_amendment.reason: Add causal pre-entry volatility-state and explicit outcome/side cells before inspecting payoff-geometry results, following literature guidance that payoff magnitude can vary more with move size/volatility than hit rate.

pre_entry_volatility_state.definition: 20-bar close-to-close realized volatility at the last completed pre-entry bar, classified against the preceding 90-bar realized-volatility distribution into causal terciles
pre_entry_volatility_state.causality: only completed bars strictly before entry are used

literature_guidance.payoff_skew_note: Low hit rate is not treated as evidence against a trend-like strategy by itself; payoff asymmetry and excursion distributions are reported separately.
literature_guidance.move_size_note: Payoff interpretation conditions on causal pre-entry volatility state rather than using hit rate alone.
literature_guidance.evidence_quality_note: Crypto/session backtests remain weak same-period evidence and are not treated as future OOS or deployment evidence.
